split_note: Sabotage plus collapse: claim the dividend or guard the fallback.

situation.title: AI Investment Collapse
situation.description: Capital flees the sector. Valuations reset hard, announced build-out is cancelled rather than delayed, and several of the arrangements European compute was depending on evaporate with it. What the frontier laboratories can afford to train shrinks for the first time.

situation.title: Export Control Escalation
situation.description: Chip and model export controls tighten again. Either allied buyers keep access on volume licences while everyone else is cut off, or the controls are drawn so tightly that allies are rationed alongside adversaries – decide which at the time from the standing American posture and from what the Union has built.

situation.title: Adoption Delivers
situation.description: Public-sector AI adoption produces visible, measurable benefit – waiting lists that fall, decisions that arrive in days rather than months, teaching that demonstrably works – and it is attributed to a European decision rather than to an American product.

situation.title: emergent_fallback_sabotage
situation.description: Coordinated physical sabotage of manual fallback infrastructure – off-books generator pools, transformer stores and breaker-log sites – by anti-AI groups treating them as collaboration with the machine system.
